dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, look! A phone shop. Is it open?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈlʊk! ə ˈfoʊn ˌʃɑːp. ɪz ɪt ˈoʊpən?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. Excuse me, what time does it close?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ɪkˈskjuːz miː, ˈwʌt ˈtaɪm dʌz ɪt ˈkloʊz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And what time does it open tomorrow?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈwʌt ˈtaɪm dʌz ɪt ˈoʊpən təˈmɑːroʊ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thanks! Emma, my dad is in the parking lot.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks! ˈɛmə, maɪ ˈdæd ɪz ɪn ðə ˈpɑːrkɪŋ ˌlɑːt.
